segments.comment: A Wizard wishes for a blessed crystal ball and creates a small mimic with wizard-mode ^G; on this seed set_mimic_sym() disguises it as an amulet beside the hero. Looking into the ball for '"' finds no amulet: detect.c clear_stale_map() unmaps the remembered amulet glyph, so object_detect() prints "You detect the absence of amulets." and calls display_nhwindow(WIN_MAP, TRUE) (detect.c:785-786). The seed was picked from eight consecutive seeds for an amulet disguise; the clock, character and keys were chosen for this path.
